#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int MAXLEN = 1 << 21;

static double cs[MAXLEN], sn[MAXLEN], csi[MAXLEN], sni[MAXLEN];
static bool fft_initialized = false;

void init_fft() {
    if (fft_initialized) return;
    double pi = acos(-1.0);
    for (int len = 1; len <= MAXLEN; len <<= 1) {
        for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
            double angle = 2 * pi * (i - len / 2) / len;
            cs[i] = cos(angle);
            sn[i] = sin(angle);
            csi[i] = cos(-angle);
            sni[i] = sin(-angle);
        }
    }
    fft_initialized = true;
}

static int bit_reverse(int x, int logn) {
    int y = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
        if (x & (1 << i))
            y |= (1 << (logn - 1 - i));
    }
    return y;
}

void fft(double *a, double *b, int n, bool inverse) {
    int logn = 0;
    int t = n;
    while (t > 1) {
        t >>= 1;
        logn++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = bit_reverse(i, logn);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[halfLen + j] : cs[halfLen + j];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[halfLen + j] : sn[halfLen + j];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int> &a, const vector<int> &b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    if (n == 1) n = 2;

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0), aImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal.data(), aImag.data(), n, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0), bImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal.data(), bImag.data(), n, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n, 0), faImag(n, 0), fbReal(n, 0), fbImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal.data(), faImag.data(), n, true);
    fft(fbReal.data(), fbImag.data(), n, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(val % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int nextInt() {
    int x;
    cin >> x;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    init_fft();

    int n = nextInt();
    int k = nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    }
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
